name: dumbbell lying woodchop
description: A woodchop done lying on your back, moving a dumbbell diagonally across your body. It works the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a dumbbell with both hands beside one hip.
Sweep the dumbbell diagonally up and across to above the opposite shoulder.
Rotate your torso with the movement.
Return under control and switch sides after the set.
